16. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that the accused herein had never presented the alleged forged DD to the Bank.
The entire prosecution case is based on the  9  C.C.No.7201/2020 forged DD presented by a person by name Manjunath.

However,
the police have never apprehended the said Manjunath and never investigated how he got the alleged DD which was standing in the name of the Accused herein.
This was very important aspect which would have linked the accused to the alleged presenter of the forged DD.
In the absence of police investigation on this aspect this court cannot come to a conclusion that the accused were the persons who had forged the DD hand in glove with the alleged Manjunath.

17 . Further the prosecution has also failed to seize the R.S. Masali vs Geetha Priya Y on 6 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18807683/

fake DD in this case.
Such being the case when the actual fake DD is not seized then the prosecution cannot themselves say that the accused tried to defraud the bank by furnishing a fake DD.
Non seizure of the DD is by itself fatal to the entire case of the prosecution.
18.At the time of the filing of chargesheet liberty was reserved to file additional charge sheet against other accused on securing them.
However, even after lapse of 6yrs no additional report was ever filed.
Hence, it is clear that the chargesheet itself was not a fully investigated charge sheet.
As stated earlier the charge sheet  10  C.C.No.7201/2020 filed by the police does not in any way link accused with the presenter of the fake DD.
The prosecution had to prove the nexus between the presenter of the DD and the accused herein.
In absence of the same the entire case of the prosecution has to fail.
Hence, in view of the above discussion, this court holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
